title: Real runtime topology
summary: The preferred live Studio path is browser -> Queue Fabric Web Gateway -> same ObjectQueueManager -> Wire UI Server -> WireUIBuilderApplication -> target project. python -m http.server can serve assets but cannot instantiate this runtime.
invariants: A browser shell loading is not proof that Queue backend/semantic path is alive.
Browser must not choose arbitrary Queue Fabric queue or receive claim tokens.
Use server-issued manifests/definitions and stale-revision enforcement.
